description: This file defines configuration options for a simple queue cache in Orleans, including a class for cache options with a default size, and a validator class to ensure the cache size is valid.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the simple queue cache, mainly the cache size with a default value.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the SimpleQueueCacheOptions to ensure proper configuration, specifically that CacheSize is larger than zero.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks that the CacheSize is greater than zero; throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new validator instance given services and a provider name.
